question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

Leisure is esential to civilization, and in former times leisure for the few was only rendered possible by the labours of the many.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"esential"** is an incorrect spelling of the word **"essential" **which means absolutely necessary or extremely important. (अत्यावश्यक)

 
 
• **Example: **Water is **essential** for all forms of life.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"essential"** which means absolutely necessary or extremely important. (अत्यावश्यक)
 
 
• **Example: **It is** essential **to wear a helmet while riding a bike.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Leisure** (अवकाश): Free time when one is not working or occupied.

 
 
• **Example: **She spends her leisure time reading books.
 
 
 
• **Possible** (संभव): Able to be done or achieved.
 
 
• **Example: **It is possible to finish the project by the deadline if we work hard.
 
 
 
• **Rendered** (प्रदान किया गया): To cause to become; to make.
 
 
• **Example: **The new policy rendered the old one obsolete.
 
 

31:Taf3,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
